newsitem.title: CANADA: Martin says lower interest rates save govt money.
newsitem.headline: Martin says lower interest rates save govt money.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Thursday that every percentage point decline in interest rates saved the government about C$1.3 billion in debt servicing costs.

"Every percentage point drop saves us about C$1.3 billion," Martin told a Nesbitt Burns conference call. "It used to be...that a percentage point would save us about C$1.7 billion, but...as we have been extending out the term (of the debt), clearly that percentage point drop brings in less."
-- Malina Poshtova Zang, Reuters Ottawa Bureau (613) 235-6745
